significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the conclusion that a "teacher-derived steering vector" present during neutral generation causally induces—and, through reverse patching, removes—the subliminally transmitted trait, with effective layers corresponding to large fine-tuning weight changes; this is primarily a form-(ii) causal claim with a limited form-(iii) layer-wise coupling. It would establish both a training-free behavioral phenomenon and a low-dimensional carrier mechanism, narrowing the unknown encoding mechanism left by Cloud et al.'s 2025 Subliminal Learning results, but it remains bounded mainly to one transmitted behavior rather than fixing expectations across models or traits. Verified false and true are distinguishable, although the negative branch is weaker: failure of this particular mean-activation vector would disfavor a single linear carrier but would not establish the claimed "distributed weight changes" alternative over nonlinear or context-dependent activation carriers. In the topic-substitution check, merely restating "extend subliminal learning" would not earn this score; the causal induction/removal and layer correspondence are the claim-specific increment, but they are close to the topic's obvious mechanistic steering hypothesis.

reach.justification: The concrete handle is the "teacher-derived steering vector," including its reverse use by subtracting it from a subliminally fine-tuned student; it is an inference-time intervention applied before behavioral output, although the suggested detection of "activation geometry rather than data" is not specified as a forward-looking predictor or gating rule. After recalibration on another model, the conclusion supplies mainly a procedure for extracting and testing another direction rather than predicting what that model's direction, layer, or effect size will be; the claim itself cautions that "effective layers/magnitudes may not transfer across traits or models." The asserted scope is therefore narrow and the immediate downstream users are principally subliminal-learning and representation-engineering researchers, with auditor uptake remaining conditional on turning activation geometry into a diagnostic. Under topic substitution, the bare topic would provide no steering handle, so the claim earns credit for a usable intervention, but not broad reach beyond the per-model probe-and-steer template.
